title: When forgiveness keeps feeling costly after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: The mind knows the wound but does not know how to loosen its grip. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru links forgiveness to freedom, fearless return, and the end of inner replay. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: Forgive deeply enough that fear loses its throne. Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment.
actionPrompt: Release one rehearsed sentence you keep feeding with resentment. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
